title: October is all about me
summary: A main-character text overlay listing the small ways this month is all about you. AI helps you write lines that sound like you.
why: A TikTok trends roundup dated October 16, 2026 lists "October is all about me": creators use a seasonal sound with on-screen text that frames the month as their main-character moment.
steps: Film a few seconds of something you love about October: a walk, a warm drink, a cosy corner.
Use the main prompt to get a short list of lines in your own voice.
Pick three or four lines and add them as text on screen, one at a time.
Choose a trending seasonal sound in the app and post.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Write 8 short lines for an on-screen text video called "October is all about me". Each line is under 8 words and starts with "October is" or "This month". Make them about small, happy things: cosy mornings, long walks, saying no to plans, treating myself. Here are three things I love about this time of year: [your three things]. Keep it light and confident, not bragging. No hashtags.

prompts.label: Variation: Canadian fall
prompts.text: Write 8 short on-screen text lines for "October is all about me", set in a Canadian fall. Think Thanksgiving leftovers, the first toque of the year, frosty windshields, hot drinks and crunchy leaves. Each line under 8 words, playful and warm. No hashtags.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [your type of business]. Write 6 short on-screen text lines for an "October is all about me" video, written as if my business is talking. Make it about small treats for my customers this month, like [your offer or fall product]. Each line under 8 words. Friendly and fun. Don't make up prices, reviews or deadlines.

tips: Give the AI your own details. Generic lines look like everyone else's.
Three or four lines is plenty. Each should stay on screen long enough to read.
Match each line to a clip, like your drink for a coffee line.
Read the list out loud and cut any line you wouldn't really say.
